text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the turn of the year, Tamamo Cross enters her classic year.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year, Trainer! Here's to another year with ya.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Gotta say though, it's lonely bein' way out here on New Year's instead of home with my family.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: But I'm not packin' my bags yet. I can't… Not until I got some big wins to bring back with me.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: These two years are gonna be our time to shine. I'm countin' on ya, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We renew the promise we made to each other. Our Twinkle Series takedown is really going to ramp up this year.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: 'Sides, even if I can't be there with 'em, I can at least call everyone. I'll have to give Mom a ring later before I go crazy…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I may not be your mother, but I'd be more than happy to be your mommy!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Wha?! Creek, you're here too?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Why yes, I'm here to welcome in the new year. Tamtam, Trainer, let's all have a wonderful twelve months!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: This year will be a very special one for me too, you see.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Well, because I'm considering entering the Twinkle Series this autumn.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I'm not quite ready to be running with you yet, Tamtam, but with enough effort, I think I can get there.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Whoa! For real?! You're gonna debut too? That's some nice news to be kickin' off the new year with!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Which reminds me… I'm pretty sure you-know-who's gonna debut, too. Hehe. Things're gonna get lively!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We'll be seeing more and more juniors debut this year. The lineup's definitely about to change in a big way.
choice_data_list: I'm curious to hear what both of your New Year's resolutions are.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh, let's see… Well, if I had to say…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I think my New Year's resolution would be to spoil Tamtam.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: You wanna do what?! That's da wishy-washiest resolution I ever heard! C'mon, make it somethin' like gettin' ya first win!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hmm. All right, let's go with that, then.
choice_data_list: What's your New Year's resolution, Tamamo Cross?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Do ya even gotta ask?! I'm gonna make everyone back home extra happy!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh… But that's been your goal for a while, hasn't it? You mentioned it a fair few times last year as well.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Well… yeah. I guess it's more of an ongoin' goal than a resolution, huh?
choice_data_list: Yeah. Why not make the New Year's one something fun and easy, then?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I don't want her burning herself out working too hard. Hopefully she'll take the suggestion…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Ya might be right, Trainer. If ya can't have a little fun at New Year's, when can ya?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hm, now what would be a fun thing to do this year…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: That's a good one! I'll work on my quips! Good comebacks have gotta be snappy, after all.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Soon as someone gives me an openin', they're gettin' roasted! Any time, anywhere!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Phew… Of all the experiences unique to New Year's, there's really nothing better than a solo run.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Get outta here! You run solo every day of da week!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: My "New Year's resolution"? A fitting question for the beginning of January. Hmm, I suppose…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: At the very least, it would have to be HD. Hehehe…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Da year's just started and you're droppin' groaners already?! Reeeal cute!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Tch, I drew a dud. Nothing lucky about this fortune slip. An amateur would call it a day. But…

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I'll pick a winner this time!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: You some kinda dummy?! Ya can't just keep pullin' till ya get da result ya want!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Huff… Huff… Trainer, it's not so easy doin' this with Tracen Academy folks…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The year's just started and there are comeback opportunities flying left, right, and center. It looks like Tamamo Cross is getting plenty of practice.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Now yer talkin'! Okay, who here's up for a takoyaki bash?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Let's all meet up at Trainer's place in twenty. I'll bring the grill.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Nice, the color's lookin' good. Another minute on the grill and they'll be good to go.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Um, Tamtam? I didn't see you put any octopus inside these takoyaki. Are they supposed to be like that?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Yep. Nothin' wrong with regular takoyaki, but I figured I'd shake things up with the fillings this time.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Just trust me, yeah? These are my special octopus-free takoyaki—I swear you're gonna dig 'em!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I take a bite of the fluffy little ball… and find a wonderful burst of flavor waiting inside. Enjoying the food together, the three of us have a relaxing New Year's.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Oh, nice! How about we go sightseein', then?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: We don't get the chance to go on casual outings all that often. Let's make good on the occasion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, to my surprise, we soon find ourselves at an art gallery.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Heh! Sure is nice checkin' out art every now 'n then. I'm a fan, ya know. Kinda.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Really? I had no idea.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Yep. I know a guy who sells antiques.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: When I was a kid, he used to show 'em to me all the time. But there sure are a lotta masterpieces here in Tokyo. They even had a piece by Umachelangelo…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I wouldn't have guessed Tamamo Cross was a fan of art. Our stroll around the gallery seems to have stimulated her imagination.
